name: dumbbell lying pronated grip maltese hold
description: Holding dumbbells out to the sides in a lying Maltese position. It is an advanced hold for the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Lie face up with a dumbbell in each hand, palms down.
Lift your arms out to the sides at about hip level.
Keep your arms straight and your body tight.
Hold the position without letting the weights drop.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower carefully.
